@everyone I'd like to invite you to welcome the challenges of week 4. Where last week was a chance to explore a little bit of the Island Week 4 is where you are, like all downtrodden in stories of fiction, tested the most. It will take co-operation and finding a sense of resolve in your characters. Of standing up to the problems of a neutral war torn island. There will be delicate political struggles, and chances to be brave. Loss has stricken us all. And this is not BFDM warning the players of more mental anguish. The island is a 3 act play. The second act is always the most fraught with challenge. How you deal with it is yours to choose. But for the sake of your arc and the characters you care for, band together, play smart and careful. People and places are not safe on their own. But where you are all together, you can maintain hope. I love you all. Please, maybe consider resolve as a part of your arc.
